speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and abnormal physical findings. To begin my assessment, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms and if you have noticed any fevers or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Given your age and the 6-month duration of fatigue with weight loss despite a good appetite, have you noticed any night sweats, loss of appetite, or pain in your bones or back?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Myeloma

Given your age, 6-month history of fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and normal appetite, have you experienced any bone pain (specifically in your back or hips), frequent infections, or changes in your urine color? Also, have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your legs?
